title: KENSHI FULL ANATOMY — Every System Decomposed for KenshiReborn
goal: Eat ALL of Kenshi. Build it BETTER in sovereign Rust. Offer to Lo-Fi Games as Kenshi 2 engine BEFORE Kenshi 2 ships on Unreal.

renderer.reborn: barraCuda WGSL + coralReef Vulkan f64 SPIR-V → RTX 5090 32GB
renderer.advantage: Native GPU compute, WGSL shaders, Vulkan f64 for physics precision, 32GB VRAM vs Ogre's DX11 overhead

physics.original: NVIDIA PhysX (4.4MB) + Havok (.hkt animation, 503MB across 3995 files)
physics.reborn: barraCuda GPU compute — pure Rust physics, no vendor lock
physics.advantage: GPU-accelerated physics on any vendor (AMD/NVIDIA), not locked to PhysX

audio.reborn: sourDough audio pipeline — positional audio, procedural soundscapes
audio.advantage: Open format, procedural generation, no Wwise license ($$$)

ui.advantage: Cross-platform, web-native, WASM for browser play, touch support

sky.reborn: Procedural sky in barraCuda compute shader

particles.reborn: barraCuda GPU particle system — millions of particles
particles.advantage: GPU compute particles, 100x more particles than CPU-based

world_streaming.reborn: loamSpine data spine + sweetGrass knowledge graph

ai_system.original: FCS-defined AI (200+ task types, 70+ event triggers, AI_PACKAGE/SCHEDULE/TASK)
ai_system.reborn: squirrel MCP agents + 56 local ollama models
ai_system.advantage: LLM-driven NPC behavior, emergent intelligence, learns from play

modding.reborn: bearDog signed mods + nestGate CAS + rhizoCrypt DAG-traced
modding.advantage: Cryptographic mod signing, provenance tracking, no tampering

saves.advantage: Every save is a DAG node, verifiable history, branch/merge saves

networking.advantage: Multiplayer from day 1, epidemic gossip for distributed world state

world.terrain_heightmaps: 2 .tif files (512MB!) — the actual terrain elevation data
world.biomes: Multiple climate zones, each with unique flora/fauna/weather
world.note: 701 zones = the streaming grid. Each zone loads/unloads as player moves.

characters.note: Rich animation system: per-bodypart, injury-aware, weather-aware

buildings.note: Full building system: walls, gates, farms, mines, crafting, research

items.types: ITEM, WEAPON, ARMOUR, CROSSBOW, CONTAINER, LIMB_REPLACEMENT
items.note: Weapons, armor, prosthetic limbs, trade goods, food, materials

audio.note: Wwise sound banks — ambient, combat, weather, UI, dialogue

dialogue.note: Massive dialogue tree system driven by world state, faction relations, character personality

animals.note: Each with unique combat, behavior, breeding, hunting AI

factions.features: Diplomacy, bounties, slave trade, raids, patrols, territory control

textures.note: DDS = GPU-ready compressed textures. PNG = UI/icons.

animations.note: Per-bodypart animations, injury-aware, weather-aware, combat techniques

foliage.note: Grass, trees, plants — density and range configurable

fcs_schema.event_triggers: 70+ event types (player interaction, combat, crime, slavery, weather, faction)
fcs_schema.note: THIS IS THE ENTIRE GAME SCHEMA. Every item, character, building, faction, and behavior defined here.

the_pitch.subject: Sovereign Kenshi 2 Engine — Pure Rust, GPU-Accelerated, Open
what: We decomposed Kenshi's entire engine through provenance braids
Every mechanic traced to its source via sweetGrass attribution
Rebuilt in Pure Rust — 660KB, 484 tests, 66 .rs files
GPU-accelerated via Vulkan + WGSL (not locked to DirectX or PhysX)
LLM-driven NPC AI — 200+ task types powered by local ollama models
Multiplayer from day 1 via epidemic gossip protocol
Content-addressed assets — deduplication, verification, no corruption
DAG-traced saves — verifiable history, branch/merge, no save corruption
Cryptographic mod signing — no malware, provenance for every mod
AGPL-3.0 licensed — open source, community can contribute
advantages_over_unreal: No Epic license fee (Unreal takes 5% royalty after $1M revenue)
Pure Rust = memory safe, no crashes, no buffer overflows
Vulkan = runs on Linux natively (Kenshi 2 on Unreal = may not)
LLM-driven AI = NPCs that actually THINK, not just pathfind
Sovereign — Lo-Fi owns the engine, not Epic
the_pitch.timeline: Before Kenshi 2 ships on Unreal. The engine is ALREADY running.
